subject: Token refund & pro‑rata credit request — Oct 27 incident
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@altiomed.com>

Cc: legal@altiomed.com, billing@altiomed.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Token refund & SLA credit request for Oct 27 incident

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the incident bulletin on Oct 27. We experienced a sustained throughput degradation between 01:10–03:45 UTC that caused several inference pipelines to requeue and a spike in token consumption as our retry logic kicked in. Our finance team wants a clear proposal for a pro‑rata token refund plus the SLA credit per section 4.2 of our contract.

What we need from Redwood:
- A calculation showing refunded token quantity and the math (time window, usage baseline, pro‑rata method).
- Whether the credit will be issued as an invoice adjustment or a usable token/voucher (we prefer a voucher applied to next invoice).
- Proposed voucher id format and expected posting date.

Attached: incident_timeline_oct27.pdf (timeline from our side).

Appreciate a quick turnaround — our billing closes on the 10th.

Samira Khan
Head of Platform Ops
AltioMed Health
[Attachment: incident_timeline_oct27.pdf (pdf)]

Immediate plan:
1) Marissa (CS ops) will run the usage reconciliation and produce a pro‑rata token calculation using the same baseline period we used in other incidents.
2) Lauren (FP&A) will validate the accounting route — voucher vs invoice credit — and confirm posting timeline.
3) I’ll follow up with a single-sheet summary you can take to billing.

Target for our next update: EOD 11/02 PST. If you need it sooner, please let me know.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@altiomed.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-02T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Token refund & SLA credit request for Oct 27 incident — calculation attached

Ben / Samira — attached is the draft calculation (credit_calc_v1.xlsx) and a CSV ledger extract that shows per‑interval token deltas. Key points below.

Summary (pro‑rata token refund + SLA credit):
- Incident window used: 2026-10-27 01:10:00–03:45:00 UTC (matches your timeline).
- Baseline throughput: 5,200 tokens/min (median across prior 7 days same window).
- Observed excess due to retries and backpressure: +178,300 tokens total during window.
- Pro‑rata refund approach: refund the excess tokens above baseline on a 1:1 basis (we can also do dollar equivalent if you prefer).
- SLA credit (section 4.2): per contract, outage >60m and <8h qualifies for 5% service credit on monthly usage; applied as invoice credit.

Draft numbers (rounded):
- Token refund: 178,300 tokens (applies as a voucher code redeemable against future token usage).
- Monetary equivalent for invoicing (if needed): $0.0008 per token => $142.64 subtotal.
- SLA invoice credit (5% of monthly bill): $1,250.00 (per the invoice for Oct).
- Combined proposal if both applied: issue token voucher for 178,300 tokens + invoice credit of $1,250.00 to be posted to Oct invoice.

Notes / assumptions:
- Token unit price used is Redwood list price for standard hosted (see sheet tab ‘pricing’).
- We round voucher token counts to nearest 100 tokens for ledger simplicity.
- We will provide a voucher id and expiration (12 months) if you select the voucher route.

Attachments: credit_calc_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), credit_ledger_proposal.csv (ledger extract).

Let me know if you'd like the monetary conversion only (we can skip issuing the voucher).

—Marissa
Customer Success Ops | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: credit_calc_v1.xlsx (xlsx)] [Attachment: credit_ledger_proposal.csv (csv)]

If Samira confirms: 1) voucher redemption email (default: billing@altiomed.com), 2) choose voucher or invoice credit, we will do the following:
- Issue voucher id (format: VCHR-ALTIO-YYYYMMDD-#####) and send voucher PDF to billing.
- Post invoice credit on Nov 10 close (will appear on your Nov statement).

I can prepare the DocuSign amendment and route to Samira/legal. Ben — can you coordinate the sign-off?

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
